records.observed_result: Reproduction before the fix: an entry with maturity EXPERIMENTAL and no agent_id raised TypeError: sequence item 0: expected str instance, NoneType found while building the count message, in both enforcement points (test-portability section 1 and validate-p7-readiness.py p3_delivery_state). New mutation M27 pins the readiness enforcement point and is CAUGHT as ADAPTER_REGISTRY_INVALID. A second defect found while fixing this one: passing section 1's id-keyed dict into the new predicate made it read zero real adapters, fixed by entry_list() accepting either shape, with the same acceptance on both states re-verified. Suite after the change: portability conformance 39 passed / 0 failed / 6 controls (was 5 controls); P7 readiness mutations 30 caught-or-control-satisfied / 0 missed plus 11 caught / 0 missed (was 29; one new case); every other suite count identical to EV-RP3-010, which this record supersedes for those two counts.
